indexes.name: ix_task_pending
indexes.definition: CREATE INDEX ix_task_pending ON alembic_replay_test.background_task USING btree (next_run_at, id) WHERE ((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('PENDING'::character varying)::text, ('RETRY_WAIT'::character varying)::text]))

indexes.name: uq_chat_one_active_run
indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_chat_one_active_run ON alembic_replay_test.chat_run USING btree (tenant_id, session_id) WHERE ((status)::text = ANY (ARRAY[('PENDING'::character varying)::text, ('RUNNING'::character varying)::text]))
